mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM insurance_company_audit_application WHERE insurance_company_id = #{insuranceCompanyId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.sql: CASE ic.audit_status WHEN 0 THEN '未审核' WHEN 1 THEN '待审核' WHEN 2 THEN '审核通过' WHEN 3 THEN '审核不通过' ELSE '未知' END
mapper.select: SELECT app.id, app.insurance_company_full_name, ic.audit_status, AS audit_status_text FROM insurance_company_audit_application app LEFT JOIN insurance_company ic ON app.insurance_company_id = ic.id ORDER BY app.id DESC
